plan.summary: DIR-089 recon complete. THE HEADLINE FINDING IS THAT THIS IS FAR MORE TRACTABLE THAN DIR-088, FOR A MEASURABLE REASON: I classified all 1340 legacy colour utilities in DashboardSettings.jsx and they split 749 neutral (55.9%) versus 591 semantic (44.1%) - and the semantic bulk is INDIGO, which is not a state colour but this app PRIMARY ACCENT. Cuba already ships a purpose-built primary family (--cuba-primary, --cuba-primary-fill, --cuba-primary-soft, --cuba-primary-strong, --cuba-primary-ring, --cuba-primary-line, --cuba-primary-ink, --cuba-primary-ink-strong, --cuba-on-primary), so the indigo mapping is high-confidence rather than a guess: bg-indigo-50/100 -> --cuba-primary-soft (a real tint token, unlike the pill family), bg-indigo-600/700 -> --cuba-primary, text-indigo-600/700 -> --cuba-primary-ink / --cuba-primary-ink-strong, border-indigo-400/500 -> --cuba-primary-line, ring-indigo-500 -> --cuba-primary-ring, ring-indigo-100 -> --cuba-primary-soft. The top offenders are border-slate-200 107, text-slate-900 92, text-slate-700 87, text-slate-500 82, text-slate-400 72, border-slate-300 59, bg-slate-50 58, text-indigo-600 50, bg-slate-100 39, bg-slate-200 36, border-indigo-500 36. That means roughly 1340 minus a small emerald/red remainder is automatable with a documented table, and I will state the exact residual rather than claim 100%. SECOND FINDING - A PIN THAT DIRECTLY CONTRADICTS THE MANDATE, WHICH I AM FLAGGING RATHER THAN DISCOVERING LATE: tests/dashboard-settings-ux-10-10.test.mjs:22 REQUIRES the literal legacy gradient bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 via-purple-500 to-emerald-500, which exists at DashboardSettings.jsx:2407. The directive says eradicate the legacy colour utilities, so tokenising that gradient would break a passing test. My proposal is to supersede that one pin deliberately - replace the literal with the tokenised equivalent and update the assertion to match the token form, keeping the assertion's INTENT (a three-stop accent gradient is present) intact - and to say so explicitly in the evidence rather than quietly editing a test. I will do the same for any other pin the tokenisation legitimately invalidates, exactly as DIR-088 did for build-resume-completion-state. THIRD FINDING - THE SURFACE IS HEAVILY PINNED: 22 test files reference DashboardSettings, including dashboard-settings-ux-10-10, mfa-static, auth-mfa-ui-adversarial, oauth-password-security-ux, account-lifecycle-regression and dir075-profile-account-decoupling. I will run all of them plus the full pinned suite after every batch, not just at the end. FOURTH FINDING - A REAL INTEGRATION GAP THE DIRECTIVE CORRECTLY IDENTIFIES: CubaDensityProvider is currently used ONLY by CubaToolbar.jsx, so the Settings page is not density-aware at all; wiring it is genuine new work, not a no-op. FIFTH - THE 2FA SURFACE IS REAL AND MUST NOT REGRESS: DashboardSettings carries totpStatus (enabled, secret, backupCodes), totpSetupModalOpen, totpSetupStep, totpSetupSecret, totpEnrollmentSecret, totpQrCodeDataUrl, totpVerificationCode, totpDisableModalOpen and totpDisablePassword, plus a DIR-074 deep link that lands on the totp-se section. My changes are presentational only - I will not touch the secret lifecycle, the QR enrolment, the backup-code generation or the disable-with-password flow, and I will assert zero secret leakage (no secret in the DOM outside the intended enrolment reveal, no logging). PLAN. S1 measure first: extend the DIR-088 scorer to the Settings page so 3.7 to 9.0 is MEASURED before and after rather than asserted. S2 write the explicit mapping table - the proven DIR-088 neutral table plus the primary/soft/success/danger families with the DIR-088 lesson applied (light tints to -soft, solids to the solid token, never a tint onto a pill token). S3 apply in measured batches, biggest first, re-running the scorer and the settings test suites after each batch. S4 modernise the four tab experiences with segmented tabs, focus rings and the password/TOTP lifecycle UX including copy-to-clipboard feedback. S5 responsive at 375/768/1080 with zero horizontal overflow and real CubaDensityProvider integration. S6 tests/dir089-settings-security-mastery.test.mjs plus the full gate suite. HONEST LIMIT I AM DECLARING UP FRONT: as with DIR-088 I will not assert a 9.0 I cannot measure, and if a batch cannot be safely automated I will report it rather than mass-replace and break contrast. INVARIANTS: frozen 55 CV template modules diff 0, build under 4s, 0 lint errors, XAMPP-only servers with no detached daemon, and zero change to auth, Firebase token handling, API, DB or RBAC - this directive is presentational plus the density integration.
